crossRefs.note: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.

translations.web: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:
translations.bsb: A constant dripping on a rainy day and a contentious woman are alike—
translations.kjv: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.
translations.asv: A continual dropping in a very rainy day And a contentious woman are alike:
